title: Southern Gospel
style: upbeat Christian country song, medium beat, acoustic guitar, add fiddle, joyful male harmonies
lyrics:
We’re climbing the mountain of the Lord
On a quest to learn His Holy Word.
We’re hiking up the straight and narrow trail
With the Spirit as our Guide, we can’t fail!

Working for the Son
It’s hard, but it’s fun!
Seeking to do His will
Our mission we fulfill!

We come to know Him, following His ways
Bearing witness of Jesus all our days.
We will testify, we will share what’s true
Repent, be baptized, all will be made new!

Working for the Son
It’s hard, but it’s fun!
Seeking to do His will
Our mission we fulfill!

Love, share, and invite—we’re shining His Light
Let the deaf now hear, and the blind find sight!
Leave the world behind, its trouble and strife
Join us at His table, eat the Bread of Life!

Working for the Son
It’s hard, but it’s fun!
Seeking to do His will
Our mission we fulfill!

Working for the Son
It’s hard, but it’s fun!
Seeking to do His will
Our mission we fulfill!

Our mission we fulfill.
